title: [Feature Request] Add AnySearch support
body:
### Required prerequisites

- [x] I have searched the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions) for an existing AnySearch proposal.
- [ ] Consider asking first in a [Discussion](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions/new).

### Motivation

I'd like to use AnySearch with CAMEL agents for web search and page extraction without having to write a custom wrapper.

### Solution

I opened #4356 with an `AnySearchToolkit` that supports authenticated and anonymous search, parallel queries, vertical search, and page extraction. It works with `ChatAgent` through the existing toolkit interface.

Would this be a useful addition to CAMEL? I'm happy to adjust the interface or scope based on your feedback.

### Additional context

I opened the PR before starting this discussion, so I'm posting here to get feedback. It includes tests, an example, and a maintenance guide. All 75 focused unit tests pass locally. I've also tested the AnySearch API directly and used a CAMEL agent with DeepSeek to search and extract pages.

This work is part of AnySearch's open-source bounty program and was developed with AI assistance.
